title: file-blf.c: Formatting improvements
description:
1. Use date/time datatype for the file timestamps
2. Use FT_UINT32 for version number

notes.body: @LarsVoelker, @giovanni.musto - I didn't find any BLF files with non-zero timestamps to see if the timestamp change works as desired.  In general, I think this MR provides better datatypes for the fields to make better filters.

The trace attached to the following MR has start and end time set: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/4066

I am not sure how you would filter in the format but change looks good to me.
